null.name: Null Magic
null.description: Magic does not exist in this universe
null.note: Visitors from magical universes find their powers inert. In Mages this is a content set with no v1 cells enabled.

dead.name: Dead Magic
dead.description: Magic once existed but has been exhausted or destroyed
dead.note: 'Spellbooks contain valid formulas for power that no longer flows.' Knowledge survives and yields nothing — the one member of this family Mages' knowledge model could express directly, since instances and effect magnitudes are already separate.

anti.name: Anti-Magic
anti.description: An active force suppresses and negates all magic
anti.note: Its source has regenRate -0.1 — a negative regeneration, i.e. an ambient drain. Needs a decay term Mages does not have; the cheapest arm of this family is 'null', not this one.
